north_star: Kevin is not credited for sophisticated autonomy until routine fundamentals are independently selected, executed, verified, reused and self-repaired.
truth_rules: A heartbeat or cron cycle is not an accomplishment.
A model response is not an owner outcome.
A generated artifact is not useful until semantically verified.
One passing trial is not mastery.
A claimed repair is not a repair until the failed postcondition is independently rechecked.
Blocked is acceptable when precise; fake progress is not.

mastery_levels.name: LEARNED
mastery_levels.proof: Kevin can explain the contract, inputs, outputs, boundaries and failure cases.

mastery_levels.name: TESTED
mastery_levels.proof: Positive and negative fixture tests pass deterministically.

mastery_levels.name: PROVEN
mastery_levels.proof: One real representative task completes with machine evidence and semantic verification.

mastery_levels.name: REUSED_INDEPENDENTLY
mastery_levels.proof: A later distinct task reuses the capability without an outside engineer supplying the procedure.

mastery_levels.name: SELECTED_AUTONOMOUSLY
mastery_levels.proof: Kevin recognizes when the capability is needed, selects it from current goals/work and completes the task on a scheduled autonomous cycle.

mastery_levels.name: SELF_REPAIRED
mastery_levels.proof: When the capability breaks, Kevin fingerprints the failure, diagnoses, repairs or safely routes the repair, independently verifies it, records the lesson and resumes the original task.

skills: publish precise blockers without inventing progress
lanes.graduation: Three distinct observations correctly classify HEALTHY, DEGRADED/BLOCKED and TRUE_IDLE/NO_WORK with evidence pointers.

skills: create useful spreadsheet/text/image/app artifacts through typed tools
lanes.graduation: Three different owner-useful artifacts are created and independently checked; at least one is later reused.
Three research tasks produce source-backed decisions; one must correct or reject an initially plausible hypothesis.

skills: defer exhausted work without erasing history
lanes.graduation: Five scheduled cycles make correct work-conserving decisions with zero fabricated resets and at least two different work items selected.
Two real failure families are repaired with regression protection and independent postcondition checks.
Three bounded browser tasks complete in an isolated profile including one verified download, with negative tests for credentials/protected effects.
Three distinct Windows tasks complete with action receipts and independent state verification; arbitrary executable/path/shell requests remain rejected.

skills: resolve intended recipient from approved context
prepare call/order plan without executing consequential action
lanes.graduation: Three drafts/plans are useful and correctly remain non-sent until a scoped YELLOW execution grant exists.
Two different Kevin-owned component failures are recovered without Bess/Grok executing the repair; repeated failure family creates a watchdog/regression.

selection_policy.synthetic_drill_allowed_only_when: It exercises an unproven basic that is blocking current owner outcomes and no safer representative owner task exists.

scorecard.primary: percentage of basics at B4 or B5
scorecard.anti_metric: raw token count, model turns, cron count or animated worker count without outcome evidence
